rebinning_definition: Exact aggregation of integer cell indices on both axes; factor 2 maps 10-phd/0.02-dex cells to 20-phd/0.04-dex cells, and factor 4 maps to 40-phd/0.08-dex cells. No interpolation or new event generation.
seed_spread_definition: Mean pairwise TV between independent seed maps within each S1 mode, averaged over Parametric and Full modes; descriptive only.
limitations: Three independent pseudorandom seeds only; no bootstrap confidence interval.
Binning stability is an exact aggregation of the same events, not a new Monte Carlo.
TV is binning-dependent and is not a stand-alone model-equivalence or significance test.
NEST EFT2024 response is not official waveform-level LZ reconstruction.
DAQ, SS/data-analysis, official FV, Skin/OD, and live-time migration remain absent.
